label.en: Foreign-owned disregarded LLC with no US trade or business: when deductions matter
label.he: LLC שקוף בבעלות זרה ללא עסק בארה"ב - מתי ניכויים רלוונטיים

conditions: A foreign person is taxed in the US only on (a) FDAP income from US sources at 30% gross (treaty-reduced) - NO deductions (IRC 871(a)/881) and (b) income effectively connected with a US trade or business (ECI) - net, with deductions (IRC 871(b)/882)
Services performed outside the US are foreign-source (IRC 861(a)(3), 862(a)(3)): no US income tax and no deductions needed
Deductions against ECI are allowed ONLY if the return is timely filed (Form 1040-NR / 1120-F, IRC 874(a), 882(c)(2); Reg. 1.874-1(b)); late-filing waiver within 18 months

A single-member LLC wholly owned by a foreign person with no ECI still files pro forma Form 1120 + Form 5472 for reportable transactions (Reg. 1.6038A-1(c)); penalty $25,000 per form per year; the pro forma return does not claim business deductions

Business deductions (meals, travel, home office, QBI, SEP/Solo 401(k), SE tax) therefore have NO tax effect unless the LLC (or its owner) has a US trade or business, in which case the owner files 1040-NR with Schedule C-like Schedule E/ECI reporting
evidence: Form 5472 transaction records (capital contributions, distributions, related-party payments)
Evidence that services are performed outside the US (location of work)
Form W-8BEN given to US payers
